```{=typst}
#let people_data = yaml("/assets/people.yml")
#let people = people_data.at("people", default: ())
#let signers = signature_signers

#heading(level: 2)[Signatures]


#let signer-cells(signer) = {
  let matches = people.filter(p => p.name == signer)
  let person = if matches.len() > 0 { matches.at(0) } else { none }
  let title = if person != none and person.title != none { person.title } else { if person == none { "Not found" } else { "" } }
  let company = if person != none and person.company != none { person.company } else { "" }
  let employee-type = if person != none and person.employee_type != none { person.employee_type } else { "" }

  (
    [#signer],
    [#title],
    [#company],
    [#employee-type],
    [],
    [],
  )
}

#if signers.len() == 0 [
  #emph[No signers listed in signature_signers.]
] else [
  #table(
    columns: (2fr, 2fr, 2fr, 2fr, 3fr, 1.5fr),
    inset: 6pt,
    stroke: 0.5pt,
    table.header([Name], [Title], [Company], [Type], [Signature], [Date]),
    ..signers.map(signer => signer-cells(signer)).flatten(),
  )
]
```
